business.description: Murudeshwar Ceramics Limited is the pioneer in manufacturing world class Vitrified tiles and Ceramic tiles under the brand name "NAVEEN". It has three large-scale, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities (Sira in Karnataka & Karaikal in Pondicherry) in technical collaboration with Sacmi Imola & Breton, Italy.

outlook.statement: The Company will continue to evaluate emerging technologies relevant to its business and adopt them as appropriate, focusing on process improvements, digitalization initiatives, and enhancement of existing systems and practices.

The outlook for the Indian ceramic tiles industry remains positive, supported by strong macroeconomic fundamentals, rising urbanization, increasing housing demand, and continued investments in infrastructure and real estate development. Government initiatives focused on affordable housing, smart cities, urban infrastructure, and industrial development are expected to continue generating demand.

Global Ceramic Tiles market size in 2026 estimated at USD 228.8 billion, growing to USD 333.67 billion by 2031 at 7.84% CAGR. India ceramic tiles market expected to increase from USD 10.45 billion in 2025 to USD 11.30 billion in 2026 and reach USD 16.70 billion by 2031 at 8.12% CAGR.

The Company is closely monitoring developments relating to the implementation of the New Labour Codes and the corresponding Central and State Rules. Considering the evolving regulatory framework and implementation requirements, the Company is evaluating the potential impact of the New Labour Codes on its operations and financial statements. Pending completion of such evaluation, the impact, if any, cannot be reasonably estimated at present.

The Company has reviewed the amendments to Ind AS 1, Ind AS 7, Ind AS 107, Ind AS 12, and Ind AS 21 notified by MCA in August 2025 and determined that they do not have any significant impact on its financial statements.
